import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { actor } from "../../../backend/schema/actor";

export const actorCms = customizeTable<typeof actor>("actor", {
    display: {
        title: "firstName"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    fields: {
        firstName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastName: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    }
});
